messages:
anita: deploybot just surfaced a p95 latency spike after the us-west2 cutover. safety valve tripped and rollout paused at ~62%. holding further traffic. who can take lead?

deploybot: :warning: SAFETY-VALVE TRIGGERED
metric=latency_p95 region=us-west2 duration=00:05 threshold=250ms current=312ms
suggested_action=partial_rollback target_version=v2.2.9 affected_routes=frontend-generate,chat-api

sam k: oncall — i'm looking at traces. a handful of requests show kv-cache misses + slower kernels on this exact batch size. error rate small but latency spike consistent.

maria: can we do a targeted traffic slice rollback instead of full revert? keep the new model for internal canary.

jay: agree with targeted slice. recommend move 20% traffic back to v2.2.9 for hosted routes only, leave dedicated pools pinned to v2.2.9 already. that should reduce latency signal quickly.

sre-oncall: if we patch routing, let's also toggle autoscale down for the new pool to avoid compounding. i'll run the router change.

ops_bot: ACTION LOGGED: incident-5734 created (minor perf regression). owners: sam k, jay. comms_channel=#customer-facing-updates.

sam k: executing rollback slice: using router command below to shift slice id=slice-17 to v2.2.9
```
routerctl traffic shift --slice slice-17 --from v2.3.1 --to v2.2.9 --percent 20 --region us-west2
```
I'll post when done.

anita: copy — once traffic slice is moved, collect p95 for 10 minutes and we decide next step. if p95 drops below 240ms and error rate stable, we keep partial. else full rollback. I'll draft a short status for release notes and customer channel.

maria: quick note for release notes: update status to "degraded performance, partial rollback in progress", list affected routes and ETA for next update (~15m). I'll coordinate customer message. :thumbsup:

jay: rollback slice applied. confirming with metrics. initial p95 dropped from 312ms -> 215ms within 3 min. tracking more samples.

sam k: seeing improved traces, KV cache warm-up happening. no new 5xxs. recommend keep partial rollback and monitor for 30m, then re-evaluate rollback vs patch.

anita: sounds good. maria, please push the short note and tag the customer success lead. jay/sam keep watching. will escalate to full rollback if we see regression after warmup. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
